parameters.name: All hosts
parameters.description: Ticked by default: report on ALL hosts with needrestart-lxc deployed. Overrides the Hosts selection (untick to use the Hosts pulldown instead).

parameters.name: Hosts
parameters.description: Proxmox hosts to report on (distro explorer == proxmox). May stay empty when 'All hosts' is ticked.

parameters.name: Data source
parameters.description: Fresh scan on the hosts, or read their cached Zabbix JSON.
